ctx.x: Yeah. But I knew Chew through Roy. Roy left Fletcher to form his own group, and I went with Roy, so consequently Chew would come down and blow with us all the time. You know, all the time. He was very -- I don't know whether you're familiar with this style, but his style was just the opposite of Ben. He was the driver. Chew was a driver, he was a swinger, you know, forceful. Ben was senseless. You know. Well, Ben was definitely a senseless player. He would just tear your heart out. Chew was -- as I said -- a…
